title: 第十一章 蝼蚁与天柱第十三章 不同步的死亡
lines: 章节摘要：“战争从来不是勇敢者的游戏，而是计算者的赌局。“——牛顿
“你知道多久了？“
宁修远直接问出来，没有铺垫。
凛冬没有回避这个问题，她看向地图，声音一如既往地平：
“从你们进武库的时候，我完全清醒之后。“
“那是十八个小时前。“秦墨的语气变了，不是愤怒，是一种更冷的东西，“你知道了十八个小时，没有说。“
“因为我在等确认。“凛冬转过来看着他，“牛顿的计算和我的判断吻合了，我才开口。“
“等什么确认？“宁修远问，“你不相信我们？“
“不是信任的问题。“凛冬停了一下，这个停顿在她身上不常见，“是因为……如果我说错了，“
“如果我把三千年前的记忆和现在的现实混淆了，“
她的语气降低了一度：
“这个错误，我没有办法承担。“
作战室里安静了几秒。
宁修远看着她，理解了这句话背面的东西——三千年的沉睡，间歇性的清醒，她的“记忆“不是连续的，而是碎片的、可能失真的。她需要被独立验证，才敢把它当成事实说出口。
“那现在呢？“
“现在是确认的。“凛冬说，“我可以告诉你我知道的全部。“
她看向所有人：
“三千年前，摧毁那个文明的，不是战争，不是内乱。是一种来自柯伊伯带外的武器，使用的技术和净化阵完全一样——反物质湮灭。“
“那个文明当时把它叫做'湮灭潮汐'，是他们见过的最后一种东西。“
“天道院找到了残存的武器规格，复制了它。“她的声音第一次有了一点非常轻微的东西，宁修远说不准是什么：
“用来对付蝼蚁。“
牛顿在宁修远脑海里把计算结果投影出来，宁修远把数字说出声，作战室里的声音渐渐停了：
[反物质湮灭·预测覆盖范围：半径约500公里]
[在覆盖范围内：所有有机物质、能量场、固态结构完全湮灭]
[废土常住人口（估算）：约一百万]
[预计存活人数：0]
宁修远把最后这个数字说出来，停了一下。
没有人说话。
秦墨站在地图前，脸色是宁修远见过他最白的一次。他的嘴动了一下，然后没有声音出来，他再试了一次：
“我们……真的不知道是这个。“
他抬头看宁修远，眼睛里有一种宁修远很少在他脸上看见的东西：
“情报说是高能净化武器，我以为……我以为是驱逐，或者辐射污染……“
“你以为废土居民会跑。“宁修远说，语气没有指责，只是陈述。
秦墨闭上眼睛，然后重新睁开。
“我们还有两天半。“他声音哑了一点，“告诉我们怎么做。“
凛冬的声音从侧面传来，依然平静，但宁修远已经学会了分辨她的平静里那些细微的层次：
“天道院不是要净化废土。“
“他们是要销毁证据。“
“武库，真理火种，我们——所有知道古代文明真相的，今天都在废土里。“
content_en:
Chapter summary: "War is never a game for the brave, but a game for the calculator." - Newton
"How long have you known?"
Ning Xiuyuan asked directly without any foreshadowing.
Lin Dong did not avoid this question. She looked at the map and her voice was as calm as ever:
"From the time you entered the arsenal, after I was fully awake."
"That was eighteen hours ago." Qin Mo's tone changed. It was not angry, but something colder. "You knew it for eighteen hours and didn't say anything."
"Because I'm waiting for confirmation." Lin Dong turned to look at him, "Newton's calculations matched my judgment, so I spoke."
"What are you waiting for confirmation?" Ning Xiuyuan asked, "You don't believe us?"
"It's not a matter of trust." Lin Dong paused. This pause was unusual for her. "It's because...if I said something wrong,"
"If I confuse the memory of three thousand years ago with the current reality,"
Her tone lowered:
"I cannot afford this mistake."
The war room was quiet for a few seconds.
Ning Xiuyuan looked at her and understood what was behind this sentence - three thousand years of slumber, intermittent awakening, her "memory" was not continuous, but fragmented and possibly distorted. She needs to be independently verified before she dares to speak it out as fact.
"What now?"
"It's confirmed now." Lin Dong said, "I can tell you everything I know."
She looked at everyone:
"Three thousand years ago, it was not war or civil strife that destroyed that civilization. It was a weapon from outside the Kuiper Belt that used exactly the same technology as the purification array - antimatter annihilation."
"That civilization called it the 'Tide of Annihilation,' and it was the last thing they ever saw."
"Tiandaoyuan found the remaining weapon specifications and copied it." For the first time, there was something very slight in her voice. Ning Xiuyuan couldn't tell what it was:
"Used to deal with ants."
Newton projected the calculation results in Ning Xiuyuan's mind. Ning Xiuyuan spoke the numbers out loud, and the voices in the war room gradually stopped:
[Antimatter Annihilation·Predicted Coverage: Radius About 500 Kilometers]
[Within coverage: complete annihilation of all organic matter, energy fields, and solid structures]
[Permanent population of the wasteland (estimated): approximately one million]
[Estimated number of survivors: 0]
Ning Xiuyuan said the last number and paused for a moment.
No one spoke.
Qin Mo stood in front of the map, his face the whitest Ning Xiuyuan had ever seen him. His mouth moved, but then no sound came out. He tried again:
"We...really didn't know this."
He looked up at Ning Xiuyuan, and there was something in his eyes that Ning Xiuyuan rarely saw on his face:
"The intelligence said it was a high-energy purification weapon. I thought... I thought it was expulsion, or radiation contamination..."
"You think the residents of the wasteland will run away." Ning Xiuyuan said, his tone was not accusatory, just a statement.
Qin Mo closed his eyes and then opened them again.
"We have two and a half days." His voice became hoarse. "Tell us what to do."
Lin Dong's voice came from the side, still calm, but Ning Xiuyuan had learned to distinguish the subtle layers in her calmness:
"Tiandaoyuan is not here to purify the wasteland."
"They were going to destroy the evidence."
"Arsenal, Fire of Truth, we - all of us who know the truth of ancient civilization are in the wasteland today."
